comment: Variation of tamedog-blessed-taming-caps-punched-kitten-wizard: dog.c tamedog() 1188-1189. A debug Caveman (no pet) creates a hostile lichen, steps beside it (it appeared diagonally in a doorway) and searches with the m prefix until it touches and sticks to him (u.ustuck, not engulfed); reading an uncursed scroll of taming then reaches tamedog() with mtmp == u.ustuck, and since the hero is not a sticky form, unstuck() releases him before the lichen is tamed.
